name: @pipeworx/mcp-gong

tools.name: gong_list_calls
tools.description: List recorded calls from your workspace with optional date filtering. Returns call IDs, dates, participants, duration, and engagement metrics. Supports pagination for large result sets.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response

tools.name: gong_get_call
tools.description: Get full details for a specific call by ID. Returns participants, duration, call metadata, engagement metrics, and key moments.

tools.name: gong_get_transcript
tools.description: Retrieve the full conversation transcript for a call with speaker names, timestamps, and dialogue. Use after gong_get_call to analyze specific conversations.

tools.name: gong_list_users
tools.description: List all users in your workspace. Returns user names, IDs, email addresses, roles, and activity status.

tools.name: gong_search_calls
tools.description: Search calls by keyword or phrase (e.g., 'pricing', 'objection', 'budget'). Returns matching calls ranked by relevance.

keyword.description: Keyword to search for in calls

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-gong forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the gong pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
